page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9i.48xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed by a KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor running at a base clock speed of 3.2 GHz. It provides 192 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 384.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 2.0 GB allocated per virtual core.

The hardware configuration does not bundle local disk storage or dedicated graphics processing units, relying entirely on network-attached block storage for persistence. Network infrastructure capabilities feature a baseline network throughput of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-volume data transfer between interconnected services and storage volumes.

Due to its high core density and balanced 2.0 GB per vCPU allocation, the instance provides high compute density for parallelized execution. From a cost efficiency perspective, allocating compute resources without bundled local disks allows users to tailor block storage investments strictly to operational requirements rather than hardware overhead.

This instance configuration is suited for compute-intensive workloads that require massive multi-threading and high network throughput. Key use cases include high-performance batch processing, distributed continuous integration and deployment pipelines, large-scale web serving tiers, and scientific modeling.

The instance includes a 64 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile to support heavy data transfers across distributed environments. It contains no bundled local storage or integrated hardware accelerators, requiring external network-attached storage for system and application data. This setup delivers high compute density without requiring expenditure on unused local drives. Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9i.48xlarge is suited for parallel compute tasks, continuous integration and build workloads, large web server fleets, and CPU-bound batch processing architectures.
